# SpeciesFYI Embed Widget

> Embeddable SpeciesFYI widgets for any website. Zero dependencies, Shadow DOM isolation, 4 themes (light/dark/sepia/auto).

## Quick Start

Add to any HTML page:
- Script: <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/speciesfyi-embed@1/dist/embed.min.js"></script>

## Links

- Main site: https://speciesfyi.com
- Widget docs: https://widget.speciesfyi.com
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/speciesfyi-embed
- GitHub: https://github.com/fyipedia/speciesfyi-embed
- API: https://speciesfyi.com/developers/
